phases.name: Mobilise
phases.description: Site establishment, survey setting-out, topsoil strip and enabling works.

phases.name: Earthworks and piling
phases.description: Bulk and pad excavation, platform fill, driven piles.

phases.name: Foundations
phases.description: Footings, pile caps, equipment pads, bunds, ground slab and underground drainage.

phases.name: Structural steel and shell
phases.description: Steel frames, concrete columns, mezzanine slabs, roof and cladding, doors and windows.

phases.name: Pipe rack
phases.description: Linear rack steel and rack spool laydown.

phases.name: Equipment and modules
phases.description: Heavy lifts: process modules, tanks, pumps, vessels, transformers, switchgear.

phases.name: Piping and building services
phases.description: Process piping, tie-ins, hydrotest; HVAC ducts, terminals and sprinklers.

phases.name: Electrical and instrumentation
phases.description: Cable tray, cable, panels and field instruments.

phases.name: Insulation, coatings and finishes
phases.description: Pipe insulation, fireproofing, ceilings, floors and doors.

phases.name: Commissioning
phases.description: System-based energisation, process start-up and air balancing.

steps.name: Survey setting-out
steps.description: Survey control and setting-out of the element before ground is broken.

steps.name: Strip topsoil and prepare platform
steps.description: Topsoil strip, proof-roll and platform preparation.

steps.name: Excavate pad, trench or bulk cut
Drive piles
steps.description: Driven precast piles; needs a piling rig (see tag) and integrity testing.

steps.name: Pour equipment pad with anchor bolts
steps.description: Equipment pad; needs curing time before the heavy lift lands on it.

steps.name: Lay underground drain or duct bank
Erect steel column
steps.description: Fabricated steel; 8 week lead for shop drawings and fabrication.

steps.name: Form, reinforce and pour concrete column or beam
Pour mezzanine slab on metal deck
Install roof deck, insulation and membrane
Lift and lay pipe spools on rack
Set process module
steps.description: Skid or modular process unit. 30 week lead; needs a cured pad, crane reach and road access in the same week.

steps.name: Set power transformer
steps.description: Longest lead item on the job: 40 weeks.

steps.name: Install miscellaneous element
steps.description: Default step for any element no rule matched. Shows up in the authoring feedback list.

steps.name: Hydrotest piping
steps.description: Hold point: nothing is insulated before it passes.

steps.name: Install local panel or junction box
Insulate and clad pipe
steps.description: Insulation goes on only after the hydrotest of the system has passed.

gates.name: Ground proven before foundations
gates.description: Piles tested and platform proven in the zone before any concrete goes in.

gates.name: Foundations before steel
gates.description: Footings, pads and slabs poured and inspected before steel is erected in the zone.

gates.name: Steel and shell before heavy equipment
gates.description: Connections welded and inspected before equipment is set in the zone.

gates.name: Hydrotest before insulation
gates.description: No insulation or coating goes on until the pressure tests pass.

gates.name: Pre-commissioning before commissioning
gates.description: Whole-plant gate: flush, loop checks and megger tests complete project-wide.

gates.name: Commissioning before handover
gates.description: All systems energised and started before documentation is signed off.
